warnings: append_only: entries are never edited or removed; a correction is a new entry
no_prior_version: this is the first version of panel-travel-esim-marketplace, so there is no overlap bridge to a predecessor

changes.summary: Created the first provisional panel from a public URL and a one-line description, with no user-supplied charter, customer corpus, competitor list, budget or approver.
changes.detail: 14 sources, 6 supported ICPs (one hypothesis_only), 9 buyer jobs (two hypothesis_only), 34 canonical cells, 68 candidates, 61 accepted, 32 cells selected.

changes.summary: Rejected prompt-001c for recommendation forcing inside an unaided B3 cell.
changes.detail: The draft converted a problem statement into a supplier-selection request. cell-003 and cell-017 already measure that act.

changes.summary: Rejected prompt-014c for a target-brand token inside an unaided core cell.
changes.detail: Hard contamination failure. The equivalent aided intent is measured by cell-028 under allowed exception exc-001.

changes.summary: Quarantined prompt-022a and excluded cell-022 from the panel because its B5 story evidence is decayed.
changes.detail: source-009 is dated 2026-03-25 and describes an event whose final was 2026-07-19, six days before this run. A B5 cell needs fresh dated evidence, so no live-trend claim is made.

changes.summary: Quarantined prompt-024a and prompt-024b and excluded cell-024, leaving en-CA unmeasured.
changes.detail: en-CA locale review is pending and only company-asserted CAD price rendering distinguishes the locale. prompt-024b is additionally grade D.

changes.summary: Quarantined prompt-021c as an unsupported grade-D expansion.
changes.detail: No source supports the operator-revenue framing. Retained rather than deleted so the discovery option survives if industry evidence is added.

changes.summary: Routed prompt-007c back to generation for asking two concepts at once and forcing a provider answer.
changes.detail: Repairable by dropping the appended cheapest-provider clause; the sizing intent is already covered by prompt-007a.

changes.summary: Recorded waivers W-001 through W-007 rather than padding the panel to the diagnostic default.
changes.detail: Unaided cell count is 25 against a 30-48 default. Partner, loyalty, non-English locale and global-package coverage are explicitly excluded with the evidence each would need.

changes.summary: Recorded blocked-evidence limitation for review, community and app-store sources.
changes.detail: Trustpilot returned HTTP 403, Reddit and travel.stackexchange could not be fetched, both app-store listings returned 404, one GSMA page returned 403 and one buying guide was behind a membership wall. Only source-006 is direct buyer-written language.
